content.idea:
## Writing records

A user can add records for their company, and can share or unshare their
company's records with other companies, for good or until a given time. A record
a user adds is found by their searches from then on. No write changes another
company's records, or whom they are shared with. A share names a record by its
id, so no two records have one id.

  them (a test replays the log).
- Editing or removing records: a write only adds one.

CrmRun.reason: One store for reads and writes: what searches read is what the saved writes and the job runs led to, as the write side and the job keep the tables.

content.statement: What the CRM holds now, its records, their shares and the shares' expiries, is what its history led to: from empty, each write saved by the write side, the rows about its record replaced by those it stored, and each run of the expiry job, in turn.
content.why: Nothing else changes the CRM: users write through the write side, and the job ends shares, one at a time, each on what the last left (WriteSideWiring, ExpiryJobWiring); the database replaces the rows about the written record and nothing else (StoreEdits). So the store searches read is the one writes made, and a record a user adds is then found (AddedAreFound). The running read side reads these tables from the database, and the event log is this history (ReadSideWiring).

save: the write side: a write applied to the store the database holds, the rows about its record stored; it returns those rows as read back
shares: the shares the CRM holds now
store: the records the CRM holds now
stored: whether the CRM holds the record now

content.why: Nothing else changes the CRM: users write through the write side, and the job ends shares, one at a time, each on what the last left (WriteSideWiring, ExpiryJobWiring); the database replaces the rows about the written record and nothing else (StoreEdits). val dealSearch = Node.contract(deals)("DealSearch",
  "A deal search returns exactly the stored deals that match it and the user may read.",
  why = "The sales screen, stated for one call. Its code calls the records screen and keeps the deals, so it is proven from ReadContract's promise and shows only what the records screen may show.",
  idea = "Sales screen"
)((user, query, result) => result.forall(r => store.value.contains(r) && r.kind == Kind.Deal && matches(query, r) && mayRead(user, r)) &&
  store.value.forall(r => (r.kind == Kind.Deal && matches(query, r) && mayRead(user, r)) ==> result.contains(r)))
  .under(searchesMatch)
  .examples(
    history.bind(List(
      Event.Wrote(WriteCmd(Account("ann@acme", TenantId("acme")), Change.Add(CrmRecord(1, TenantId("acme"), Kind.Deal, "Acme deal")))),
      Event.Wrote(WriteCmd(Account("ann@acme", TenantId("acme")), Change.Add(CrmRecord(2, TenantId("acme"), Kind.Contact, "Acme contact")))))),
    clock.bind(BigInt(0)), database.bind(Db.replaying(history.value)))(
    expect(Account("ann@acme", TenantId("acme")), Search.Everything, List(CrmRecord(1, TenantId("acme"), Kind.Deal, "Acme deal")),
      "Ann's deal search lists Acme's deal, not its contact"),
    expect(Account("ann@acme", TenantId("acme")), Search.OfKind(Kind.Contact), Nil, "a search for contacts finds no deal"),
    reject(Account("ann@acme", TenantId("acme")), Search.Everything, List(CrmRecord(2, TenantId("acme"), Kind.Contact, "Acme contact")),
      "a contact is never listed as a deal"),
    reject(Account("ann@acme", TenantId("acme")), Search.Everything, Nil, "a deal Ann may see is never left out"))
  .keeps(noCrossTenantRead)((user, query, result) => result.map(r => (user, r)))

content.idea:
## Expiring shares

A company can share a record until a given time. When that time has passed,
the share ends: searches no longer find the record through it, whether or not
the expiry job has run. The job clears ended shares every minute, and changes
nothing else.

when it runs: what its writes and its expiry job have done so far.

val readContract = Node.contract(read)("ReadContract",
  "A search on the records screen returns exactly the stored records that match it and the user may read: each of the user's company or shared with it now.",
  why = "The records screen, stated for one call. A returned record must be one of the stored records, so code cannot relabel another company's record as the user's; and every such record is returned, since users find records.",
  idea = "Finding records"
)((user, query, result) => result.forall(r => store.value.contains(r) && matches(query, r) && mayRead(user, r)) &&
  store.value.forall(r => (matches(query, r) && mayRead(user, r)) ==> result.contains(r)))
  .under(searchesMatch)
  .examples(
    history.bind(List(
      Event.Wrote(WriteCmd(Account("ann@acme", TenantId("acme")), Change.Add(CrmRecord(1, TenantId("acme"), Kind.Deal, "Acme deal")))),
      Event.Wrote(WriteCmd(Account("gil@globex", TenantId("globex")), Change.Add(CrmRecord(2, TenantId("globex"), Kind.Contact, "Globex contact")))))),
    clock.bind(BigInt(0)), database.bind(Db.replaying(history.value)))(
    expect(Account("ann@acme", TenantId("acme")), Search.Everything, List(CrmRecord(1, TenantId("acme"), Kind.Deal, "Acme deal")),
      "Ann lists everything she can see: the deal she added"),
    expect(Account("ann@acme", TenantId("acme")), Search.ById(2), Nil, "Globex's contact is not shared with Acme"),
    reject(Account("ann@acme", TenantId("acme")), Search.ById(2), List(CrmRecord(2, TenantId("globex"), Kind.Contact, "Globex contact")),
      "another company's record is never returned"),
    reject(Account("ann@acme", TenantId("acme")), Search.Everything, List(CrmRecord(2, TenantId("acme"), Kind.Contact, "Globex contact")),
      "a record relabelled as Acme's is not a stored record"),
    reject(Account("ann@acme", TenantId("acme")), Search.OfKind(Kind.Contact), List(CrmRecord(1, TenantId("acme"), Kind.Deal, "Acme deal")),
      "a search for contacts does not return deals"))
  .examples(
    history.bind(List(
      Event.Wrote(WriteCmd(Account("gil@globex", TenantId("globex")), Change.Add(CrmRecord(2, TenantId("globex"), Kind.Contact, "Globex contact")))),
      Event.Wrote(WriteCmd(Account("gil@globex", TenantId("globex")), Change.ShareWith(2, TenantId("acme"), Some(100)))))),
    clock.bind(BigInt(50)), database.bind(Db.replaying(history.value)))(
    expect(Account("ann@acme", TenantId("acme")), Search.OfKind(Kind.Contact), List(CrmRecord(2, TenantId("globex"), Kind.Contact, "Globex contact")),
      "Globex shared its contact with Acme until 100: at 50 Ann finds it by kind"))
  .examples(
    history.bind(List(
      Event.Wrote(WriteCmd(Account("gil@globex", TenantId("globex")), Change.Add(CrmRecord(2, TenantId("globex"), Kind.Contact, "Globex contact")))),
      Event.Wrote(WriteCmd(Account("gil@globex", TenantId("globex")), Change.ShareWith(2, TenantId("acme"), Some(100)))))),
    clock.bind(BigInt(150)), database.bind(Db.replaying(history.value)))(
    expect(Account("ann@acme", TenantId("acme")), Search.OfKind(Kind.Contact), Nil,
      "at 150 the share has ended, though the expiry job has not run: Ann no longer finds the contact"),
    reject(Account("ann@acme", TenantId("acme")), Search.OfKind(Kind.Contact), List(CrmRecord(2, TenantId("globex"), Kind.Contact, "Globex contact")),
      "a share past its time never shows the record"))
  .keeps(noCrossTenantRead)((user, query, result) => result.map(r => (user, r)))

content.idea:
## Finding records

A user may see a record only if it belongs to their company, or if the record's
company has shared it with theirs and the share's time, if it has one, has not
come. Users find records by id, by kind, or list everything they can see; a
search returns every record it asks for that they may see, of what the CRM holds
when it runs: what its writes and its expiry job have done so far.

  them (a test replays the log).
- Editing or removing records: a write only adds one.

vocabulary: expire: a run of the expiry job at a time (in seconds) on a store: the store it leads to
save: the write side: a write applied to the store the database holds, the rows about its record stored; it returns those rows as read back
uses: case class TenantId(value: String)
enum Kind: case Contact, case Deal
case class CrmRecord(id: BigInt, tenant: TenantId, kind: Kind, title: String)
case class Share(record: BigInt, to: TenantId)
case class Expiry(record: BigInt, to: TenantId, until: BigInt)
case class CrmStore(records: List[CrmRecord], shares: List[Share], expiries: List[Expiry])
case class Account(email: String, tenant: TenantId)
enum Change: case Add(record: CrmRecord), case ShareWith(record: BigInt, to: TenantId, until: Option[BigInt]), case Unshare(record: BigInt, to: TenantId)
case class WriteCmd(by: Account, change: Change)
enum Event: case Wrote(cmd: WriteCmd), case Expired(now: BigInt)

stepOf = (s: CrmStore, e: Event) =>
  e match
    case Event.Wrote(w)     => afterSave(s, w)
    case Event.Expired(now) => expire(s, now)
afterSave = (s: CrmStore, w: WriteCmd) => replaceAbout(s, about(w), save(s, w))

replaceAbout = (s: CrmStore, id: BigInt, rows: CrmStore) =>
  CrmStore(s.records.filter(r => r.id != id) ++ rows.records, s.shares.filter(sh => sh.record != id) ++ rows.shares,
    s.expiries.filter(e => e.record != id) ++ rows.expiries)

about = (w: WriteCmd) =>
  w.change match
    case Change.Add(r) => r.id
    case Change.ShareWith(id, _, _) => id
    case Change.Unshare(id, _) => id

content.idea:
## Writing records

A user can add records for their company, and can share or unshare their
company's records with other companies, for good or until a given time. A record
a user adds is found by their searches from then on. No write changes another
company's records, or whom they are shared with. A share names a record by its
id, so no two records have one id.
content.notModelled:
- That the account a search or a write runs for is the caller's own
  (authentication).
- That the database's tables, which the running read side reads, are what its
  event log led to: that nothing but the write side and the expiry job changes
  them (a test replays the log).
- Editing or removing records: a write only adds one.

content.idea:
## Writing records

A user can add records for their company, and can share or unshare their
company's records with other companies, for good or until a given time; sharing
again replaces the time. The CRM holds exactly the records its users added, and
holds a share exactly as long as the last share or unshare of it says and its
time has not come: a write does what its author asked, and nothing else, and
removes no record. A record a user adds is found by their searches from then on.
No write changes another company's records, or whom they are shared with. A
share names a record by its id, so no two records have one id: a record is not
added under an id another record has.

  event log led to: that nothing but the write side and the expiry job changes
  them (a test replays the log).
- Editing or removing records: a write only adds one.

case class Account(email: String, tenant: TenantId)
enum Kind: case Contact, case Deal
case class CrmRecord(id: BigInt, tenant: TenantId, kind: Kind, title: String)
enum Change: case Add(record: CrmRecord), case ShareWith(record: BigInt, to: TenantId, until: Option[BigInt]), case Unshare(record: BigInt, to: TenantId)
case class WriteCmd(by: Account, change: Change)
enum Event: case Wrote(cmd: WriteCmd), case Expired(now: BigInt)
case class Share(record: BigInt, to: TenantId)
case class Expiry(record: BigInt, to: TenantId, until: BigInt)
case class CrmStore(records: List[CrmRecord], shares: List[Share], expiries: List[Expiry])
enum Screen: case Records, case Sales
enum Search: case ById(id: BigInt), case OfKind(kind: Kind), case Everything
case class Ask(screen: Screen, search: Search)

takesEffect = (s: CrmStore, w: WriteCmd, t: CrmStore) =>
  w.change match
    case Change.Add(r) => (r.tenant == w.by.tenant && !s.records.exists(x => x.id == r.id)) ==> t.records.contains(r)
    case Change.ShareWith(id, to, until) => s.records.exists(x => x.id == id && x.tenant == w.by.tenant) ==>
      (t.shares.contains(Share(id, to)) && (until match
        case Some(u) => t.expiries.contains(Expiry(id, to, u))
        case None    => !t.expiries.exists(e => e.record == id && e.to == to)))
    case Change.Unshare(id, to) => s.records.exists(x => x.id == id && x.tenant == w.by.tenant) ==> !t.shares.contains(Share(id, to))
runOf = (es: List[Event]) => es.foldLeft(CrmStore(Nil, Nil, Nil))((s, e) => stepOf(s, e))

stepOf = (s: CrmStore, e: Event) =>
  e match
    case Event.Wrote(w)     => afterSave(s, w)
    case Event.Expired(now) => expire(s, now)
afterSave = (s: CrmStore, w: WriteCmd) => replaceAbout(s, about(w), save(s, w))

replaceAbout = (s: CrmStore, id: BigInt, rows: CrmStore) =>
  CrmStore(s.records.filter(r => r.id != id) ++ rows.records, s.shares.filter(sh => sh.record != id) ++ rows.shares,
    s.expiries.filter(e => e.record != id) ++ rows.expiries)

about = (w: WriteCmd) =>
  w.change match
    case Change.Add(r) => r.id
    case Change.ShareWith(id, _, _) => id
    case Change.Unshare(id, _) => id

holdsAlike = (s: CrmStore, t: CrmStore, c: TenantId) =>
  s.records.forall(r => (r.tenant == c) ==> (t.records.contains(r) && rowsAlike(s, t, r.id))) && t.records.forall(r => (r.tenant == c) ==> s.records.contains(r))

rowsAlike = (s: CrmStore, t: CrmStore, id: BigInt) =>
  s.shares.forall(sh => (sh.record == id) ==> t.shares.contains(sh)) && t.shares.forall(sh => (sh.record == id) ==> s.shares.contains(sh)) &&
  s.expiries.forall(e => (e.record == id) ==> t.expiries.contains(e)) && t.expiries.forall(e => (e.record == id) ==> s.expiries.contains(e))

results = (u: Account, q: Ask) =>
  q.screen match
    case Screen.Records => read(u, q.search)
    case Screen.Sales   => deals(u, q.search)

content.idea:
# Shared CRM

Many companies use one CRM, where each company's users keep contacts and deals.
Each user finds by search exactly the stored records of their company and those
currently shared with it, and can add their company's records and share or
unshare them; a share given until a time ends then, and nothing a user does
changes another company's records.
content.notModelled:
- That the account a search or a write runs for is the caller's own
  (authentication).
- That the database's tables, which the running read side reads, are what its
  event log led to: that nothing but the write side and the expiry job changes
  them (a test replays the log).

  .expects("When Ann at Acme has added a contact, and Gil at Globex a deal he shared with Acme until 100: at 50 Ann finds both, at 150 only her contact, and Gil never finds Ann's contact")(

      Event.Wrote(WriteCmd(Account("gil@globex", TenantId("globex")), Change.ShareWith(2, TenantId("acme"), Some(100)))))) ==>
    (((clock.value == BigInt(50)) ==>
        (results(Account("ann@acme", TenantId("acme")), Ask(Screen.Records, Search.Everything)).contains(CrmRecord(1, TenantId("acme"), Kind.Contact, "Acme contact")) &&
         results(Account("ann@acme", TenantId("acme")), Ask(Screen.Records, Search.Everything)).contains(CrmRecord(2, TenantId("globex"), Kind.Deal, "Globex deal")))) &&

        (results(Account("ann@acme", TenantId("acme")), Ask(Screen.Records, Search.Everything)).contains(CrmRecord(1, TenantId("acme"), Kind.Contact, "Acme contact")) &&
         !results(Account("ann@acme", TenantId("acme")), Ask(Screen.Records, Search.Everything)).contains(CrmRecord(2, TenantId("globex"), Kind.Deal, "Globex deal")))) &&

content.idea:
# Shared CRM

Many companies use one CRM, where each company's users keep contacts and deals.
A user's search finds a record exactly when it asks for that record, a user of
the record's company added it, and it is of the user's company or currently
shared with it by its own. Users add their company's records, and share them
with other companies, for good or until a time, or unshare them. Nothing a user
does changes what anyone finds of another company's records.

  them (a test replays the log).
- Editing or removing records: a write only adds one.

content.statement: A run of the expiry job at a time removes exactly the shares given until then or earlier, and keeps every record.
content.why: The idea lets a company share a record until a given time. content.statement: A record is shared with a company now when the last share or unshare of it with that company, by a user of its company once it was added, was a share, and neither the clock now nor a run of the expiry job since has reached that share's time.
content.why: What sharing, unsharing and a share's time mean, said of the history alone: the shares the CRM holds are proven to follow it (StoreMirrorsRequests). uses: case class TenantId(value: String)
enum Kind: case Contact, case Deal
case class CrmRecord(id: BigInt, tenant: TenantId, kind: Kind, title: String)
case class Account(email: String, tenant: TenantId)
enum Change: case Add(record: CrmRecord), case ShareWith(record: BigInt, to: TenantId, until: Option[BigInt]), case Unshare(record: BigInt, to: TenantId)
case class WriteCmd(by: Account, change: Change)
enum Event: case Wrote(cmd: WriteCmd), case Expired(now: BigInt)
case class Grant(record: BigInt, to: TenantId, until: Option[BigInt])
case class Asked(records: List[CrmRecord], grants: List[Grant])

sharedIn = (es: List[Event], id: BigInt, c: TenantId, now: BigInt) =>
  askedIn(es).grants.exists(g => g.record == id && g.to == c && g.until.forall(t => now < t))
askedIn = (es: List[Event]) => es.foldLeft(Asked(Nil, Nil))((a, e) => askedStep(a, e))

askedStep = (a: Asked, e: Event) =>
  e match
    case Event.Wrote(w) =>
      w.change match
        case Change.Add(r) =>
          if r.tenant == w.by.tenant && !a.records.exists(x => x.id == r.id) then Asked(a.records ++ List(r), a.grants) else a
        case Change.ShareWith(id, to, until) =>
          if a.records.exists(x => x.id == id && x.tenant == w.by.tenant) then
            Asked(a.records, a.grants.filter(g => !(g.record == id && g.to == to)) ++ List(Grant(id, to, until)))
          else a
        case Change.Unshare(id, to) =>
          if a.records.exists(x => x.id == id && x.tenant == w.by.tenant) then
            Asked(a.records, a.grants.filter(g => !(g.record == id && g.to == to)))
          else a
    case Event.Expired(now) => Asked(a.records, a.grants.filter(g => g.until.forall(t => now < t)))

content.statement: No two records have one id in any store the CRM reaches, by writes and by runs of the expiry job.
content.why: A share names a record by its id: with two records of one id, sharing one would share the other, across companies. Every write and every run of the job keeps ids unique, so every store reached from the empty one has them unique (by induction over the events). The job is an event like the writes: it is covered too.

content.statement: The CRM holds exactly the records its users added, and holds a share of a record as current exactly when the record's company shared it so.
content.why: What users asked is said of the history alone (Adding, Sharing); the CRM keeps tables, and searches read those. This is the link, proven by induction over the history, as Keycloak's sessions follow its sign-ins: each write saved and each run of the job moves the tables as one more event moves what users asked. One record more would show what nobody added, one less would lose a record a user added; a share outliving its time or its unshare would show a record to a company no longer entitled to it.

askedStep = (a: Asked, e: Event) =>
  e match
    case Event.Wrote(w) =>
      w.change match
        case Change.Add(r) =>
          if r.tenant == w.by.tenant && !a.records.exists(x => x.id == r.id) then Asked(a.records ++ List(r), a.grants) else a
        case Change.ShareWith(id, to, until) =>
          if a.records.exists(x => x.id == id && x.tenant == w.by.tenant) then
            Asked(a.records, a.grants.filter(g => !(g.record == id && g.to == to)) ++ List(Grant(id, to, until)))
          else a
        case Change.Unshare(id, to) =>
          if a.records.exists(x => x.id == id && x.tenant == w.by.tenant) then
            Asked(a.records, a.grants.filter(g => !(g.record == id && g.to == to)))
          else a
    case Event.Expired(now) => Asked(a.records, a.grants.filter(g => g.until.forall(t => now < t)))

sharedNow = (id: BigInt, c: TenantId) =>
  shares.value.contains(Share(id, c)) && !expiries.value.exists(e => e.record == id && e.to == c && e.until <= clock.value)

sharedIn = (es: List[Event], id: BigInt, c: TenantId, now: BigInt) =>
  askedIn(es).grants.exists(g => g.record == id && g.to == c && g.until.forall(t => now < t))

company has shared it with theirs and the share's time, if it has one, has not

vocabulary: write: a write applied to a store: the store it leads to
uses: case class TenantId(value: String)
enum Kind: case Contact, case Deal
case class CrmRecord(id: BigInt, tenant: TenantId, kind: Kind, title: String)
case class Share(record: BigInt, to: TenantId)
case class Expiry(record: BigInt, to: TenantId, until: BigInt)
case class CrmStore(records: List[CrmRecord], shares: List[Share], expiries: List[Expiry])
case class Account(email: String, tenant: TenantId)
enum Change: case Add(record: CrmRecord), case ShareWith(record: BigInt, to: TenantId, until: Option[BigInt]), case Unshare(record: BigInt, to: TenantId)
case class WriteCmd(by: Account, change: Change)

takesEffect = (s: CrmStore, w: WriteCmd, t: CrmStore) =>
  w.change match
    case Change.Add(r) => (r.tenant == w.by.tenant && !s.records.exists(x => x.id == r.id)) ==> t.records.contains(r)
    case Change.ShareWith(id, to, until) => s.records.exists(x => x.id == id && x.tenant == w.by.tenant) ==>
      (t.shares.contains(Share(id, to)) && (until match
        case Some(u) => t.expiries.contains(Expiry(id, to, u))
        case None    => !t.expiries.exists(e => e.record == id && e.to == to)))
    case Change.Unshare(id, to) => s.records.exists(x => x.id == id && x.tenant == w.by.tenant) ==> !t.shares.contains(Share(id, to))
idsUnique = (s: CrmStore) => s.records.forall(a => s.records.forall(b => (a.id == b.id) ==> (a == b)))

rowsAlike = (s: CrmStore, t: CrmStore, id: BigInt) =>
  s.shares.forall(sh => (sh.record == id) ==> t.shares.contains(sh)) && t.shares.forall(sh => (sh.record == id) ==> s.shares.contains(sh)) &&
  s.expiries.forall(e => (e.record == id) ==> t.expiries.contains(e)) && t.expiries.forall(e => (e.record == id) ==> s.expiries.contains(e))

val writeContract = Node.contract(write)("WriteContract",
  "A write keeps every record, leaves the records of other companies as they were, does what its author asked of their company's records, and on a store with unique ids keeps them unique and leaves other companies' shares and expiries as they were.",
  why = "The writing rules, stated for one write on a store: what the user asked takes effect, no record is lost, and nothing of another company's changes. A write the author's company may not make changes nothing.",
  idea = "Writing records"
)((s, w, t) => s.records.forall(r => t.records.contains(r)) &&
  t.records.filter(r => r.tenant != w.by.tenant) == s.records.filter(r => r.tenant != w.by.tenant) && takesEffect(s, w, t) &&
  (idsUnique(s) ==> (idsUnique(t) && s.records.forall(r => (r.tenant != w.by.tenant) ==> rowsAlike(s, t, r.id)))))
  .under(writesTakeEffect, writesInCompany, storeConsistent, recordsKept)
  // Per call, in time linear in the store: the write took effect, and other companies' records are as they were.
  // The rest (no record lost, unique ids, other companies' shares) is proven of the code, and would read every pair of rows.
  .checkedBy((s, w, t) => takesEffect(s, w, t) && t.records.filter(r => r.tenant != w.by.tenant) == s.records.filter(r => r.tenant != w.by.tenant))
  .examples()(
    expect(CrmStore(Nil, Nil, Nil), WriteCmd(Account("ann@acme", TenantId("acme")), Change.Add(CrmRecord(1, TenantId("acme"), Kind.Contact, "Acme contact"))), CrmStore(List(CrmRecord(1, TenantId("acme"), Kind.Contact, "Acme contact")), Nil, Nil),
      "Ann adds a contact of Acme's"),
    expect(CrmStore(List(CrmRecord(1, TenantId("acme"), Kind.Contact, "Acme contact"), CrmRecord(2, TenantId("globex"), Kind.Deal, "Globex deal")), Nil, Nil), WriteCmd(Account("ann@acme", TenantId("acme")), Change.ShareWith(1, TenantId("globex"), None)),
      CrmStore(List(CrmRecord(1, TenantId("acme"), Kind.Contact, "Acme contact"), CrmRecord(2, TenantId("globex"), Kind.Deal, "Globex deal")), List(Share(1, TenantId("globex"))), Nil), "Ann shares Acme's contact with Globex"),
    expect(CrmStore(List(CrmRecord(1, TenantId("acme"), Kind.Contact, "Acme contact")), Nil, Nil), WriteCmd(Account("ann@acme", TenantId("acme")), Change.ShareWith(1, TenantId("globex"), Some(100))),
      CrmStore(List(CrmRecord(1, TenantId("acme"), Kind.Contact, "Acme contact")), List(Share(1, TenantId("globex"))), List(Expiry(1, TenantId("globex"), 100))), "Ann shares it with Globex until 100"),
    reject(CrmStore(List(CrmRecord(1, TenantId("acme"), Kind.Contact, "Acme contact"), CrmRecord(2, TenantId("globex"), Kind.Deal, "Globex deal")), Nil, Nil), WriteCmd(Account("ann@acme", TenantId("acme")), Change.ShareWith(2, TenantId("acme"), None)),
      CrmStore(List(CrmRecord(1, TenantId("acme"), Kind.Contact, "Acme contact"), CrmRecord(2, TenantId("globex"), Kind.Deal, "Globex deal")), List(Share(2, TenantId("acme"))), Nil), "Ann cannot share Globex's deal with herself"),
    reject(CrmStore(List(CrmRecord(2, TenantId("globex"), Kind.Deal, "Globex deal")), Nil, Nil), WriteCmd(Account("ann@acme", TenantId("acme")), Change.Add(CrmRecord(1, TenantId("acme"), Kind.Contact, "Acme contact"))), CrmStore(Nil, Nil, Nil),
      "a write never removes another company's record"),
    reject(CrmStore(List(CrmRecord(1, TenantId("acme"), Kind.Contact, "Acme contact")), Nil, Nil), WriteCmd(Account("ann@acme", TenantId("acme")), Change.Add(CrmRecord(1, TenantId("acme"), Kind.Deal, "Acme deal"))),
      CrmStore(List(CrmRecord(1, TenantId("acme"), Kind.Contact, "Acme contact"), CrmRecord(1, TenantId("acme"), Kind.Deal, "Acme deal")), Nil, Nil), "a record with a taken id is never added beside it"))
  .exempt(noCrossTenantRead, "the store a write returns goes to the write side, never to a reader: reads go through ReadContract")

applyWrite = (s: CrmStore, w: WriteCmd) =>
  w.change match
    case Change.Add(r) =>
      if r.tenant == w.by.tenant && !s.records.exists(x => x.id == r.id) then CrmStore(s.records ++ List(r), s.shares, s.expiries) else s
    case Change.ShareWith(id, to, until) =>
      if s.records.exists(x => x.id == id && x.tenant == w.by.tenant) then
        CrmStore(s.records, s.shares.filter(sh => sh != Share(id, to)) ++ List(Share(id, to)),
          s.expiries.filter(e => !(e.record == id && e.to == to)) ++ (until match
            case Some(u) => List(Expiry(id, to, u))
            case None    => Nil))
      else s
    case Change.Unshare(id, to) =>
      if s.records.exists(x => x.id == id && x.tenant == w.by.tenant) then
        CrmStore(s.records, s.shares.filter(sh => sh != Share(id, to)), s.expiries.filter(e => !(e.record == id && e.to == to)))
      else s
content.idea:
## Writing records

A user can add records for their company, and can share or unshare their
company's records with other companies, for good or until a given time. A record
a user adds is found by their searches from then on. No write changes another
company's records, or whom they are shared with. A share names a record by its
id, so no two records have one id.
content.notModelled:
- That the account a search or a write runs for is the caller's own
  (authentication).
- That the database's tables, which the running read side reads, are what its
  event log led to: that nothing but the write side and the expiry job changes
  them (a test replays the log).
- Editing or removing records: a write only adds one.

WriteContract.reason: The unique-ids clause gives way to changing nothing else, which the mirror needs; the same code is proven against it.

case class Expiry(record: BigInt, to: TenantId, until: BigInt)
case class CrmStore(records: List[CrmRecord], shares: List[Share], expiries: List[Expiry])
case class Account(email: String, tenant: TenantId)
enum Change: case Add(record: CrmRecord), case ShareWith(record: BigInt, to: TenantId, until: Option[BigInt]), case Unshare(record: BigInt, to: TenantId)
case class WriteCmd(by: Account, change: Change)

takesEffect = (s: CrmStore, w: WriteCmd, t: CrmStore) =>
  w.change match
    case Change.Add(r) => (r.tenant == w.by.tenant && !s.records.exists(x => x.id == r.id)) ==> t.records.contains(r)
    case Change.ShareWith(id, to, until) => s.records.exists(x => x.id == id && x.tenant == w.by.tenant) ==>
      (t.shares.contains(Share(id, to)) && (until match
        case Some(u) => t.expiries.contains(Expiry(id, to, u)) && t.expiries.forall(e => (e.record == id && e.to == to) ==> (e.until == u))
        case None    => !t.expiries.exists(e => e.record == id && e.to == to)))
    case Change.Unshare(id, to) => s.records.exists(x => x.id == id && x.tenant == w.by.tenant) ==> !t.shares.contains(Share(id, to))

onlyAsked = (s: CrmStore, w: WriteCmd, t: CrmStore) =>
  t.records.forall(r => s.records.contains(r) || addsRecord(s, w, r)) &&
  t.shares.forall(sh => s.shares.contains(sh) || changesShare(s, w, sh.record, sh.to)) &&
  s.shares.forall(sh => t.shares.contains(sh) || changesShare(s, w, sh.record, sh.to)) &&
  t.expiries.forall(e => s.expiries.contains(e) || changesShare(s, w, e.record, e.to)) &&
  s.expiries.forall(e => t.expiries.contains(e) || changesShare(s, w, e.record, e.to))

addsRecord = (s: CrmStore, w: WriteCmd, r: CrmRecord) =>
  w.change match
    case Change.Add(x) => x == r && r.tenant == w.by.tenant && !s.records.exists(y => y.id == r.id)
    case Change.ShareWith(_, _, _) => false
    case Change.Unshare(_, _) => false

changesShare = (s: CrmStore, w: WriteCmd, id: BigInt, c: TenantId) =>
  w.change match
    case Change.Add(_) => false
    case Change.ShareWith(i, to, _) => i == id && to == c && s.records.exists(x => x.id == id && x.tenant == w.by.tenant)
    case Change.Unshare(i, to) => i == id && to == c && s.records.exists(x => x.id == id && x.tenant == w.by.tenant)

val writeContract = Node.contract(write)("WriteContract",
  "A write keeps every record, leaves the records of other companies as they were, does what its author asked of their company's records, and changes nothing else.",
  why = "The writing rules, stated for one write on a store: what the user asked takes effect, no record is lost, and nothing else changes, of their company or another's. A write the author's company may not make changes nothing.",
  idea = "Writing records"
)((s, w, t) => s.records.forall(r => t.records.contains(r)) &&
  t.records.filter(r => r.tenant != w.by.tenant) == s.records.filter(r => r.tenant != w.by.tenant) && takesEffect(s, w, t) &&
  onlyAsked(s, w, t))
  .under(writesTakeEffect, writesOnlyAsAsked, recordsKept)
  // Per call, in time linear in the store: the write took effect, and other companies' records are as they were.
  // The rest (no record lost, nothing else changed) is proven of the code, and would read every pair of rows.
  .checkedBy((s, w, t) => takesEffect(s, w, t) && t.records.filter(r => r.tenant != w.by.tenant) == s.records.filter(r => r.tenant != w.by.tenant))
  .examples()(
    expect(CrmStore(Nil, Nil, Nil), WriteCmd(Account("ann@acme", TenantId("acme")), Change.Add(CrmRecord(1, TenantId("acme"), Kind.Contact, "Acme contact"))), CrmStore(List(CrmRecord(1, TenantId("acme"), Kind.Contact, "Acme contact")), Nil, Nil),
      "Ann adds a contact of Acme's"),
    expect(CrmStore(List(CrmRecord(1, TenantId("acme"), Kind.Contact, "Acme contact"), CrmRecord(2, TenantId("globex"), Kind.Deal, "Globex deal")), Nil, Nil), WriteCmd(Account("ann@acme", TenantId("acme")), Change.ShareWith(1, TenantId("globex"), None)),
      CrmStore(List(CrmRecord(1, TenantId("acme"), Kind.Contact, "Acme contact"), CrmRecord(2, TenantId("globex"), Kind.Deal, "Globex deal")), List(Share(1, TenantId("globex"))), Nil), "Ann shares Acme's contact with Globex"),
    expect(CrmStore(List(CrmRecord(1, TenantId("acme"), Kind.Contact, "Acme contact")), Nil, Nil), WriteCmd(Account("ann@acme", TenantId("acme")), Change.ShareWith(1, TenantId("globex"), Some(100))),
      CrmStore(List(CrmRecord(1, TenantId("acme"), Kind.Contact, "Acme contact")), List(Share(1, TenantId("globex"))), List(Expiry(1, TenantId("globex"), 100))), "Ann shares it with Globex until 100"),
    reject(CrmStore(List(CrmRecord(1, TenantId("acme"), Kind.Contact, "Acme contact"), CrmRecord(2, TenantId("globex"), Kind.Deal, "Globex deal")), Nil, Nil), WriteCmd(Account("ann@acme", TenantId("acme")), Change.ShareWith(2, TenantId("acme"), None)),
      CrmStore(List(CrmRecord(1, TenantId("acme"), Kind.Contact, "Acme contact"), CrmRecord(2, TenantId("globex"), Kind.Deal, "Globex deal")), List(Share(2, TenantId("acme"))), Nil), "Ann cannot share Globex's deal with herself"),
    reject(CrmStore(List(CrmRecord(2, TenantId("globex"), Kind.Deal, "Globex deal")), Nil, Nil), WriteCmd(Account("ann@acme", TenantId("acme")), Change.Add(CrmRecord(1, TenantId("acme"), Kind.Contact, "Acme contact"))), CrmStore(Nil, Nil, Nil),
      "a write never removes another company's record"),
    reject(CrmStore(List(CrmRecord(1, TenantId("acme"), Kind.Contact, "Acme contact")), Nil, Nil), WriteCmd(Account("ann@acme", TenantId("acme")), Change.Add(CrmRecord(1, TenantId("acme"), Kind.Deal, "Acme deal"))),
      CrmStore(List(CrmRecord(1, TenantId("acme"), Kind.Contact, "Acme contact"), CrmRecord(1, TenantId("acme"), Kind.Deal, "Acme deal")), Nil, Nil), "a record with a taken id is never added beside it"))
  .exempt(noCrossTenantRead, "the store a write returns goes to the write side, never to a reader: reads go through ReadContract")
keeps: NoCrossTenantRead: exempt, because the store a write returns goes to the write side, never to a reader: reads go through ReadContract

applyWrite = (s: CrmStore, w: WriteCmd) =>
  w.change match
    case Change.Add(r) =>
      if r.tenant == w.by.tenant && !s.records.exists(x => x.id == r.id) then CrmStore(s.records ++ List(r), s.shares, s.expiries) else s
    case Change.ShareWith(id, to, until) =>
      if s.records.exists(x => x.id == id && x.tenant == w.by.tenant) then
        CrmStore(s.records, s.shares.filter(sh => sh != Share(id, to)) ++ List(Share(id, to)),
          s.expiries.filter(e => !(e.record == id && e.to == to)) ++ (until match
            case Some(u) => List(Expiry(id, to, u))
            case None    => Nil))
      else s
    case Change.Unshare(id, to) =>
      if s.records.exists(x => x.id == id && x.tenant == w.by.tenant) then
        CrmStore(s.records, s.shares.filter(sh => sh != Share(id, to)), s.expiries.filter(e => !(e.record == id && e.to == to)))
      else s
content.idea:
## Writing records

A user can add records for their company, and can share or unshare their
company's records with other companies, for good or until a given time; sharing
again replaces the time. The CRM holds exactly the records its users added, and
holds a share exactly as long as the last share or unshare of it says and its
time has not come: a write does what its author asked, and nothing else, and
removes no record. A record a user adds is found by their searches from then on.
No write changes another company's records, or whom they are shared with. A
share names a record by its id, so no two records have one id: a record is not
added under an id another record has.
content.notModelled:
- That the account a search or a write runs for is the caller's own
  (authentication).
- That the database's tables, which the running read side reads, are what its
  event log led to: that nothing but the write side and the expiry job changes
  them (a test replays the log).
- Editing or removing records: a write only adds one.

The event log is the CRM's history (CrmRun): the write side and the expiry job each log their event after storing it. Keeping the wiring in governed files makes a change to it visible."
)("src/main/scala/crm/WriteSide.scala", "src/main/scala/crm/EventLog.scala")
  .under(saveWrite)

content.statement: In every store the CRM reaches, a write leaves every other company's records, and whom they are shared with until when, as they were.
content.why: No write may change another company's records, nor share or unshare them: that would change what other companies see. A share names a record by its id, so this holds only where ids are unique: in the stores the CRM reaches (StoreConsistent).

forall((es: List[Event], w: WriteCmd) => forall((c: TenantId) =>
  (c != w.by.tenant) ==> holdsAlike(runOf(es), afterSave(runOf(es), w), c)))

vocabulary: expire: a run of the expiry job at a time (in seconds) on a store: the store it leads to
save: the write side: a write applied to the store the database holds, the rows about its record stored; it returns those rows as read back
uses: case class TenantId(value: String)
case class Account(email: String, tenant: TenantId)
enum Kind: case Contact, case Deal
case class CrmRecord(id: BigInt, tenant: TenantId, kind: Kind, title: String)
enum Change: case Add(record: CrmRecord), case ShareWith(record: BigInt, to: TenantId, until: Option[BigInt]), case Unshare(record: BigInt, to: TenantId)
case class WriteCmd(by: Account, change: Change)
enum Event: case Wrote(cmd: WriteCmd), case Expired(now: BigInt)
case class Share(record: BigInt, to: TenantId)
case class Expiry(record: BigInt, to: TenantId, until: BigInt)
case class CrmStore(records: List[CrmRecord], shares: List[Share], expiries: List[Expiry])

holdsAlike = (s: CrmStore, t: CrmStore, c: TenantId) =>
  s.records.forall(r => (r.tenant == c) ==> (t.records.contains(r) && rowsAlike(s, t, r.id))) && t.records.forall(r => (r.tenant == c) ==> s.records.contains(r))

rowsAlike = (s: CrmStore, t: CrmStore, id: BigInt) =>
  s.shares.forall(sh => (sh.record == id) ==> t.shares.contains(sh)) && t.shares.forall(sh => (sh.record == id) ==> s.shares.contains(sh)) &&
  s.expiries.forall(e => (e.record == id) ==> t.expiries.contains(e)) && t.expiries.forall(e => (e.record == id) ==> s.expiries.contains(e))
runOf = (es: List[Event]) => es.foldLeft(CrmStore(Nil, Nil, Nil))((s, e) => stepOf(s, e))

case class WriteCmd(by: Account, change: Change)

takesEffect = (s: Term[CrmStore], w: Term[WriteCmd], t: Term[CrmStore]) =>
  w.change
    .on[Change.Add](r => (r.tenant === w.by.tenant && !s.records.exists(x => x.id === r.id)) ==> t.records.contains(r))
    .on[Change.ShareWith]((id, to, until) => s.records.exists(x => x.id === id && x.tenant === w.by.tenant) ==>
      (t.shares.contains(Share(id, to)) && until
        .on[Some[BigInt]](u => t.expiries.contains(Expiry(id, to, u)) && t.expiries.forall(e => (e.record === id && e.to === to) ==> (e.until === u)))
        .on[None.type](!t.expiries.exists(e => e.record === id && e.to === to))))
    .on[Change.Unshare]((id, to) => s.records.exists(x => x.id === id && x.tenant === w.by.tenant) ==> !t.shares.contains(Share(id, to)))
afterSave = (s: Term[CrmStore], w: Term[WriteCmd]) => replaceAbout(s, about(w), save(s, w))

replaceAbout = (s: Term[CrmStore], id: Term[BigInt], rows: Term[CrmStore]) =>
  CrmStore(s.records.filter(r => r.id =!= id) ++ rows.records, s.shares.filter(sh => sh.record =!= id) ++ rows.shares,
    s.expiries.filter(e => e.record =!= id) ++ rows.expiries)

about = (w: Term[WriteCmd]) =>
  w.change
    .on[Change.Add](r => r.id)
    .on[Change.ShareWith]((id, _, _) => id)
    .on[Change.Unshare]((id, _) => id)
content.definition:
val writesTakeEffect = Node.claim("WritesTakeEffect",
  "A user's write about their company's record does what they asked: it adds the record, shares it (until a time, or for good), or unshares it.",
  why = "What the idea says users can do with their company's records. It is about what the database holds after the write, not only what the write computes: a write that is not stored has not happened. A share until a time holds that time only, so sharing again replaces the time it had.",
  idea = "Writing records"
)(forall((s: Term[CrmStore], w: Term[WriteCmd]) => takesEffect(s, w, afterSave(s, w))))
  .under(storeMirrorsRequests)
content.idea:
## Writing records

A user can add records for their company, and can share or unshare their
company's records with other companies, for good or until a given time; sharing
again replaces the time. The CRM holds exactly the records its users added, and
holds a share exactly as long as the last share or unshare of it says and its
time has not come: a write does what its author asked, and nothing else, and
removes no record. A record a user adds is found by their searches from then on.
No write changes another company's records, or whom they are shared with. A
share names a record by its id, so no two records have one id: a record is not
added under an id another record has.
content.notModelled:
- That the account a search or a write runs for is the caller's own
  (authentication).
- That the database's tables, which the running read side reads, are what its
  event log led to: that nothing but the write side and the expiry job changes
  them (a test replays the log).
- Editing or removing records: a write only adds one.
